name: 163 Mail
description: Search, read, and organize messages through 163 Mail IMAP/SMTP, and create drafts or send mail. Cindy stores the client authorization password securely and provides it to the plugin Worker only while handling a mail request.
whenToUse: Use when the user needs to find, read, or organize 163 Mail messages, create a draft, or send mail. Before first use, enter the 163 Mail address and client authorization password in the plugin details and complete the connection test.

mail_163_status.description: Check whether 163 Mail is configured. Returns only the email address and connection status, never the client authorization password.

mail_163.description: Perform 163 Mail operations: list folders, search, read, send, save drafts, mark messages read or unread, and move messages. Each operation opens a temporary IMAP/SMTP connection and closes it afterward. Sending, moving, and changing read status require explicit user intent. Compose with draft/reply/reply_all/forward (reply_all is the default reply); drafts appear as editable Cindy cards. send_draft sends the card after a 10-second undo countdown, only after the user confirms. Direct send is not supported.
